verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for an agent product like this, but the evidence shows no public Grok Bot API. The OpenAPI spec at docs.x.ai covers xAI's separate model REST API and contains zero grok-bot paths, and Grok Bot is driven only through its own desktop and mobile apps. Event-triggered routines via Cursor integrations (Slack/GitHub) are an adjacent feature, not a programmatic API, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
